node.title: Tiger Teams Model and AI Integrity Management Systems
node.reading:
AI integrity is presented as an operational condition: the transformed system must remain trustworthy while work continues. Governance, evidence and intervention therefore remain connected to the mission boundary.

The enterprise-function proposal concerns responsibility that persists after implementation. Specify the operating boundary, the specialist authorities, the exception path and the receiving owner. A delivery team can build the mechanisms, but the handover must identify who can maintain and revise them during normal operation.

In mission-critical transformation, the project ends the moment operational integrity collapses.

This is the central principle behind the JubAp.Net approach to AI Integrity Management Systems.

Integrity is not treated as an external compliance layer, a cybersecurity checklist, an ethics policy, a governance dashboard or a post-deployment audit exercise. It is the condition that allows a transformed operation to remain trustworthy while it continues running.
node.readingSummary: AI integrity is presented as an operational condition: the transformed system must remain trustworthy while work continues.

relations: A shared integrity label becomes useful only when the mission states which cross-domain conditions affect trustworthy operation and who owns them.
Eliminar fronteras de vocabulario no elimina obligaciones legales, independencia de revisión ni especialización necesaria.
Mission-level operational integrity and an enterprise integrity function operate at different scopes and should connect through explicit responsibilities rather than be collapsed into one role.
No delegación total del cliente ni fusión legal de unidades. La legitimidad de la decisión sigue en sus titulares.
Transformation integrity requires revisiting the assumptions behind the integrity boundary when the intervention changes the operating regime itself.
Un cambio no implica automáticamente invalidez total ni demuestra que todo el sistema esté fuera de su región aceptada.
A Tiger Team can contribute field evidence and implementation discipline without its delivery result becoming proof of the mathematical or architectural layers above it.
El puente de PR57 es interpretación de investigación pendiente de revisión, no equivalencia demostrada entre niveles.
For a complementary reading, see [AI Integrity Management as an enterprise function](https://tegrity.ai/the-case-for-ai-integrity-management-as-a-formal-enterprise-function/).
For a complementary reading, see [The system-level limits of locally correct controls](https://tegrity.ai/when-the-controls-work-but-the-system-fails/).
